correctness.rationale: The derived ideal is preserved by every derivation, and Leibniz forces the action there to be ρ(A). On Λ²U, U∧W, and Λ²W the eigenvalues are 2,1,0. Thus ρ(A)²=ρ(A) forces r≤1 outside characteristic two, while the off-diagonal idempotency equation gives B(W)⊂U∧W and B(U)⊂ker ρ(A). The central intersection of the image is U∧W and its quotient image is U, giving rank r+r(d−r). Counting projections by an r-space and a complementary kernel, then counting B in the resulting vector spaces, gives both polynomials including the r=0 and r=d endpoints. Brackets of image lifts span Λ²U; for r≥2 in characteristic two this is nonzero and disjoint from the central intersection, so the image is not even closed under brackets. For r≤1 its bracket with the whole algebra is contained in U∧W, giving an abelian ideal. Geometrically, a rank-r projector represents an ordered complementary pair of subspaces, the open complement locus in a product of Grassmannians. The tautological splitting gives the stated vector bundle of allowed B. Distinct characteristic polynomials separate the finitely many rank strata even in characteristic two, proving the clopen reduced component and smoothness assertions.
residual_risks: The independent replay only addresses d=3 over F2. The exact proof supplies other cases and the reduced geometry; no unreduced scheme or independent exhaustive F3 result is claimed.
